entries.label: ZEX_HELLO_1
entries.body:
Ah! Human visitors! What a treat!
I am Admiral ZEX. Please do not be frightened. Unlike the rest of my species, I... enjoy humans.
You may know me by my reputation, my leadership of VUX forces during the war with your Alliance.
I assure you that this behavior, a sad necessity of those times, belies a much kinder, gentler being.
Please be welcome! We can get to know one another... expand our interspecies relationship.
But wait. How silly of me. You aren't here for polite repartee.
You have come for my Shofixti Maidens.

entries.translation:
啊！人類訪客！ 真令人愉悅！
我是澤克斯上將。 請不要害怕。與其他同族不 同，我……喜歡人類。
你或許聽過我的名聲； 與你們聯盟交戰期間， 是我領導 VUX 軍隊。
我向你保證，那種行為只是 當時令人遺憾卻無可避免的 必要手段，掩蓋了我更親 切、更溫柔的本性。
歡迎！我們可以彼此熟 悉……拓展我們的跨物種關 係。
等等。我真傻。 你不是來禮貌寒暄的。
你是來取回我的索菲克斯提 少女。

entries.label: ZEX_HELLO_2
entries.body:
Why I am so blessed! My favorite friends, the humans, are back.
Captain, it is good to see you again.
You Humans are so interesting, so... beautiful.
You know, I have many pictures of your species!
I keep them on my walls to... inspire me.

entries.translation:
我真是太有福氣了！ 我最喜愛的朋友，人類， 又回來了。
船長，很高興再見到你。
你們人類真有趣，真是…… 美麗。
你知道嗎，我有許多你們物 種的圖片！
我把它們掛在牆上，用 來……激發靈感。

entries.label: ZEX_HELLO_3
entries.body:
Captain! You are back so soon!
We had better be discreet (hee! hee!), or my countrymen will begin whispering about us.
entries.source:

We had better be discreet (hee! hee!), or my countrymen will begin whispering about us.
entries.translation:
船長！你這麼快就回來了！
我們最好低調一點（嘻！ 嘻！），不然我的同胞會開 始議論我們。

entries.label: ZEX_HELLO_4
entries.body: Luscious, robust human... I have eagerly awaited your return.
entries.source: Luscious, robust human... I have eagerly awaited your return.
entries.translation: 甜美、健壯的人類…… 我一直熱切盼望你歸來。

entries.label: FIGHT_OR_TRADE_1
entries.body: Captain! You escaped after all! How remarkable!
entries.source: Captain! You escaped after all! How remarkable!
entries.translation: 船長！你終究還是逃出來 了！真了不起！

entries.label: FIGHT_OR_TRADE_2
entries.body:
Human... we should be friends, not enemies!
The scope of our relationship can grow as close as you wish.
entries.source:
Human... we should be friends, not enemies!
The scope of our relationship can grow as close as you wish.
entries.translation:
人類……我們應該當朋友， 不該當敵人！
我們的關係可以如你所願， 變得無比親密。

entries.label: what_you_do_here
entries.body: What are you doing here, Admiral ZEX?
entries.source: What are you doing here, Admiral ZEX?
entries.translation: 澤克斯上將，你在這裡做什 麼？

entries.label: MY_MENAGERIE
entries.body:
Ah, such a good question! But you always were a bright species.
I will explain.
After the Great War, in which I played some small part
the VUX high council, in recognition for my services
granted me this planet, so that I might pursue my... hobby
without disturbing the general VUX populace.
I am a collector, you see.
I have the finest menagerie of... beautiful... creatures in all space.

entries.translation:
啊，多麼好的問題！ 不過你們向來是聰明的物 種。
我來解釋。
大戰結束後——我在其中也 出了一點微薄之力——
VUX 最高議會為表彰我的功勞
把這顆行星賜給我， 讓我可以追求自己的…… 嗜好
而不打擾一般 VUX 民眾。
你看，我是個收藏家。
我擁有全太空最精美的…… 美麗……生物珍藏。

entries.label: what_about_menagerie
entries.body: A menagerie? Is this a collection of animals, like a zoo?
entries.source: A menagerie? Is this a collection of animals, like a zoo?
entries.translation: 生物珍藏？就是像動物園一 樣，收藏動物嗎？

entries.label: NEED_NEW_CREATURE
entries.body:
Animals? Hee! Hee! Hee! Oh, no, Captain! Not mere animals!
My menagerie contains only the most... beautiful... creatures in the galaxy!
Each of my children, as I like to call them, has a wonderful set of traits
which make them unique and special... especially to me!
I have a complete variety of beasts from as far away as Procyon and Vega.
No, this is not just some `zoo'!
I have worked diligently for many years to craft my menagerie, to gradually improve it.
Perhaps you can't tell, but I am rather proud of it!
Alas, there is one creature, one GORGEOUS animal which I do not yet possess.
I would give almost ANYTHING for that creature, Captain.

entries.translation:
動物？嘻！嘻！嘻！喔， 不，船長！可不是普通動 物！
我的珍藏中只有銀河系 最……美麗……的生物！
我喜歡把牠們叫作孩子， 每個孩子都有一組奇妙特質
使牠們獨一無二、 十分特別……尤其是對我而 言！
我收藏了各式各樣的野獸， 最遠來自南河三與織女一。
不，這可不只是什麼「動物 園」！
我多年來勤奮經營自己的珍 藏，逐步加以改良。
也許你看不出來， 但我相當以此為傲！
唉，還有一種生物， 一隻美得驚人的動物， 是我尚未擁有的。
為了得到牠，我幾乎什麼都 願意付出，船長。

entries.label: what_about_creature
entries.body: If we went and got this little critter for you, would you give us the Shofixti Maidens?
entries.source: If we went and got this little critter for you, would you give us the Shofixti Maidens?
entries.translation: 如果我們替你抓來這隻小傢 伙，你會把索菲克斯提少女 交給我們嗎？

entries.label: ABOUT_CREATURE
entries.body:
Hmmm... what an interesting proposal!
I never would have thought of such a wonderful idea myself.
You are a genius, Captain!
In answer to your question, yes! I accept your offer.
Deliver the creature to me, and I shall give you the Shofixti Maidens.
I will even provide you with a clue to finding the creature's native planet!
My source for this information is an ancient wildlife handbook
written millenia ago by some unknown alien author. The pertinent passage goes as follows
`... demise, It(!) basks in yellow light within the constellation Linch-Nas-Ploh.'
We have translated `Linch-Nas-Ploh' to mean approximately
`the long, thin creature who has swallowed the huge beast.'
I am afraid this is all that I know.
I hope it is sufficient.

嗯……多麼有趣的提議！
我自己絕對想不到這麼美妙 的主意。
你真是個天才，船長！
回答你的問題：是的！ 我接受你的提議。
把那隻生物送來， 我就把索菲克斯提少女交給 你。
我甚至會提供一條線索， 幫助你找到牠的原生行星！
這項資訊來自一本古老的野 生動物手冊
由某位不知名的外星作者在 數千年前寫成。 相關段落如下
「……滅亡，牠 （！）沐浴在林奇－納斯－ 普洛星座的黃光之中。」
我們將「林奇－納斯－普 洛」約略翻譯為
「吞下巨獸的細長生物」。
恐怕我只知道這些。
希望已經足夠。

entries.label: about_creature_again
entries.body: Would you tell me again where I can find that creature you want so badly?
entries.source: Would you tell me again where I can find that creature you want so badly?
entries.translation: 能再告訴我一次， 該到哪裡尋找你如此渴望的 生物嗎？

entries.label: CREATURE_AGAIN
entries.body:
Certainly, my smooth-skinned friend!
My source for this information is an ancient wildlife handbook
written millenia ago by some unknown alien author. The pertinent passage goes as follows
`... demise, It(!) basks in yellow light within the constellation Linch-Nas-Ploh.'

entries.label: i_have_beast
entries.body: Admiral ZEX, we have captured the hideous monster from Delta Lyncis. Let us make an exchange.
entries.source: Admiral ZEX, we have captured the hideous monster from Delta Lyncis. Let us make an exchange.
entries.translation: 澤克斯上將，我們已捕獲天 貓座德爾塔的醜陋怪獸。 來交換吧。

entries.label: GIVE_BEAST
entries.body:
Ah, a most excellent piece of news! My chiton rasps and moistens with excitement!
I have been looking forward to this for so long! Hee! Hee! Hee!
My subordinates stand ready to receive the beast from your ship, Captain.
Effect its transfer and then... we shall give you the Maidens you desire.

entries.translation:
啊，多麼美妙的好消息！ 我的幾丁質甲殼因興奮而摩 擦、變得濕潤！
我期待這一刻太久了！嘻！ 嘻！嘻！
我的部下已準備好從你的船 接收那頭野獸，船長。
把牠送過來，然後…… 我們就會交出你想要的少 女。

entries.label: ok_take_beast
entries.body: Okay, the beast is ALL yours! But be careful, it's a killer!
entries.source: Okay, the beast is ALL yours! But be careful, it's a killer!
entries.translation: 好吧，那頭野獸全歸你了！ 但要小心，牠會殺人！

entries.label: FOOL_AIEE0
entries.body:
Ah! My new child is on board. Such a big one, isn't he!?...
...and so frisky!
I am delighted beyond words that you have given me the beast, Captain
but I am afraid that there has been a slight change in our plans. Regrettable, but necessary.
Oh, my beautiful, luscious human, I had thought that the hideous, violent monster you have given me
would complete my collection of Ugliness, my Menagerie of Monsters... I was wrong!
YOU, my human love, are the most vile, the most fierce and wretched!
My collection could never be complete without you. I need you, Captain.
But alas, I fear you will not give your consent willingly. Am I right?
Therefore, sub-commander DAX, terminate communications... warm up my modified Intruder.
Engage the Precursor warp nullifier. Hee! Hee! Hee!... prepare for battle!

entries.translation:
啊！我的新孩子已經上船 了。牠真大隻，對 吧！？……
……而且這麼活潑！
船長，你把野獸送給我， 令我欣喜得難以言喻
但恐怕我們的計畫稍有改 變。令人遺憾， 卻有其必要。
喔，我美麗、甜美的人類， 我原以為你送來的醜陋暴力 怪獸
會完成我的醜陋收藏， 我的怪獸珍藏……我錯了！
你，我的人類愛人， 才是最卑劣、最凶猛也最可 憐的！
沒有你，我的收藏永遠不可 能完整。我需要你，船長。
但唉，恐怕你不會自願同 意。對不對？
所以，達克斯副指揮官， 中斷通訊……預熱我的改裝 入侵艦。
啟動先驅者躍遷抑制器。 嘻！嘻！嘻！…… 準備戰鬥！

entries.label: FOOL_AIEE1
entries.body:
Sub-commander? Why has my main console become inoperative?
The transmit mode is locked!
What do you mean the central system computer is damaged? How!?...
...the Beast!?... Escaped!!
No, Sub-Commander, this is impossible. It couldn't escape from our strongest containment system
IT'S WHAT?!! Decks five and six?! Eleven Crewmen!!
Sound the alarms, you fool! Where is it now?! Engineering, report!... Engineering?!
Sub-Commander, seal Bulkhe-- Sub-Commander... are you listening to me? What are you staring at?
PAY ATTENTION, Sub-Commander! Give me a report on its posit-- WHAT ARE YOU STARING AT!...
behind me?
WH- Wh- what- wh- AIEEEEE!!!!!...

entries.translation:
副指揮官？我的主控臺為什 麼失效了？
傳輸模式鎖死了！
中央系統電腦受損是什麼意 思？怎麼會！？……
……那頭野獸！？…… 逃走了！！
不，副指揮官，這不可能。 牠不可能逃出我們最牢固的 收容系統
牠怎麼了？！！ 第五和第六層甲板？！ 十一名船員！！
拉警報，你這蠢貨！ 牠現在在哪裡？！輪機部， 回報！……輪機部？！
副指揮官，封鎖艙壁——副 指揮官……你有在聽嗎？ 你盯著什麼？
專心點，副指揮官！ 回報牠的位——你到底在盯 什麼！……
我背後？
什、什、什麼——啊咿咿咿 咿！！！！！！……

entries.label: why_trust_1
entries.body: Ah, Admiral ZEX, aren't you forgetting something? The Shofixti Maidens?
entries.source: Ah, Admiral ZEX, aren't you forgetting something? The Shofixti Maidens?
entries.translation: 啊，澤克斯上將， 你是不是忘了什麼？ 索菲克斯提少女呢？

entries.label: TRUST_1
entries.body:
Oh yes, no problem. Even now my subordinates are bringing them up from the surface.
So let's not waste time. Send that delightful beast over, immediately!
entries.source:
Oh yes, no problem. Even now my subordinates are bringing them up from the surface.
So let's not waste time. Send that delightful beast over, immediately!
entries.translation:
喔，對，沒問題。 我的部下現在已經在把她們 從地表帶上來。
所以別浪費時間了。 立刻把那頭可愛的野獸送過 來！

entries.label: why_trust_2
entries.body: Look, we believe in 1 for 1 trades. We will transfer the beast when we see the Maidens.
entries.source: Look, we believe in 1 for 1 trades. We will transfer the beast when we see the Maidens.
entries.translation: 聽著，我們相信一物換一 物。見到少女後， 我們才會轉移野獸。

entries.label: TRUST_2
entries.body:
Captain, Captain, we are both creatures of honor.
If I say that the Shofixti Maidens are on their way up from the surface, then they are.
You will have them shortly, accept my word... now please, Captain, the beast?
entries.source:
Captain, Captain, we are both creatures of honor.
If I say that the Shofixti Maidens are on their way up from the surface, then they are.
You will have them shortly, accept my word... now please, Captain, the beast?
entries.translation:
船長，船長，我們都是重視 榮譽的生物。
我既然說索菲克斯提少女正 在從地表送上來， 她們就確實在路上。
你很快就會得到她們， 請相信我的話……現在， 船長，能把野獸交來嗎？

entries.label: why_trust_3
entries.body: Now see here ZEX! Humans and VUX have had a pretty stormy relationship. Why should we trust you?
entries.source: Now see here ZEX! Humans and VUX have had a pretty stormy relationship. Why should we trust you?
entries.translation: 聽好了，澤克斯！人類與 VUX 的關係向來風風雨雨。 我們為什麼該信任你？

entries.label: TRUST_3
entries.body:
Really, Captain! My honor is impugned!
You have maligned me and I am deeply hurt.
I thought we had built some trust between us, different though we may be
but no, I perceive now the same bigotry and misunderstanding
which brought our two species to war!
This was our chance to cement a good relationship between Human and VUX.
With my influence, the High Council could easily have been swayed to view
the Human cause in a more favorable light.

entries.translation:
真是的，船長！ 我的榮譽受到質疑！
你出言誹謗，令我深受傷 害。
我以為儘管彼此不同， 我們仍已建立起些許信任
但不，我現在看見了同樣的 偏見與誤解
正是它們使我們兩個物種走 向戰爭！
這原本是人類與 VUX 鞏固良好關係的機會。
憑我的影響力， 大可輕易說服最高議會
用更正面的眼光看待人類的 志業。

entries.label: why_dont_you_attack
entries.body: Admiral ZEX, why don't you attack us, as all other VUX have?
entries.source: Admiral ZEX, why don't you attack us, as all other VUX have?
entries.translation: 澤克斯上將，你為什麼不像 其他 VUX 那樣攻擊我們？

entries.label: LIKE_YOU
entries.body:
Because I like Humans, Captain. I respect and admire your species.
I do not share the bigoted views of most of my people.
entries.source:
Because I like Humans, Captain. I respect and admire your species.
I do not share the bigoted views of most of my people.
entries.translation:
因為我喜歡人類，船長。 我尊重並欣賞你們的物種。
我不認同多數同胞的偏狹看 法。

entries.label: why_like_me
entries.body: Ah, Admiral ZEX? Why do you like us? We thought all VUX hated humans.
entries.source: Ah, Admiral ZEX? Why do you like us? We thought all VUX hated humans.
entries.translation: 呃，澤克斯上將？ 你為什麼喜歡我們？ 我們以為所有 VUX 都憎恨人類。

entries.label: LIKE_BECAUSE
entries.body:
No, No, not all VUX, Captain! Most... but not all.
It is true when the majority of my people view one of your species
they are forced to regurgitate
but there are those among us who have grown beyond such childishness to take a more liberal view.
We, the few sophisticates, are not subject to the whims and fads of current fashion.
Our likes and dislikes are strictly based on personal preference.
We see the... beauty in you Humans. The value in a long-term... relationship.
You are different, yes. But personally, I like difference.
In fact, I ADORE it.
Your physique is so wonderfully varied! Your multitudinous rigid appendages, your tiny double eyes
your varied skin coloration, and the delightful patchwork of hair covering only parts of your bodies
leaving other parts bare and smooth! Mmmmmm!
I value your species, Captain. I see you as just `people'... like us VUX.

entries.translation:
不，不，不是所有 VUX 都如此，船長！多數是…… 但並非全部。
的確，我多數同胞只要看見 一個你們的族人
就會忍不住反胃嘔吐
但我們之中也有人早已超越 這種幼稚反應， 採取更開放的觀點。
我們少數有教養的人， 不受當下流行的任性風潮支 配。
我們的好惡完全以個人偏好 為準。
我們看得見你們人類的…… 美。也看得見長期…… 關係的價值。
你們的確不同。 但就我個人而言， 我喜歡不同。
事實上，我愛死它了。
你們的身體多麼奇妙而多 變！眾多僵硬附肢、 兩顆小眼睛
各異的膚色，還有只覆蓋部 分身體、拼拼湊湊而又迷人 的毛髮
讓其他部位裸露而光滑！ 嗯嗯嗯嗯！
船長，我珍視你們的物種。 我把你們視為單純的「 人」……就像我們 VUX。

entries.label: are_you_a_pervert
entries.body: Whoa, Admiral ZEX! This is just a bit too weird. Are you some kind of perv-- er... aesthete?
entries.source: Whoa, Admiral ZEX! This is just a bit too weird. Are you some kind of perv-- er... aesthete?
entries.translation: 哇，澤克斯上將！ 這未免太詭異了。 你是某種變態——呃…… 唯美主義者嗎？

entries.label: CALL_ME_WHAT_YOU_WISH
entries.body:
You have talked with my VUX countrymen, haven't you?
They are closed-minded fools... bigoted in all ways.
Call me what you wish, Captain. I choose to view myself as, well
simply open-minded... free to experience the full range of life's possibilities.
The VUX rulers could not refuse my military genius, couldn't ignore the many victories I gave them.
But they would not tolerate my behavior, accept my desires as natural
so they sent me out here... a hero's exile! Where  I won't `poison' the minds of youth
with my `bizarre' ideas and `perverted' lifestyle. Hmmph... bigoted fools.
You see, Captain, we are not all that different, you and I.
We are different from the majority of VUX, and so we, in VUX eyes, are both monsters.

entries.translation:
你和我的 VUX 同胞談過了，對吧？
他們是思想封閉的蠢貨…… 各方面都充滿偏見。
船長，你想怎麼稱呼我都 行。我選擇把自己看作，嗯
只是一個思想開放的人…… 可以自由體驗生命中的一切 可能。
VUX 統治者無法拒絕我的軍事天 才，也不能忽視我帶給他們 的眾多勝利。
但他們不肯容忍我的行為， 也不肯接受我的欲望出於自 然
所以把我送來這裡…… 讓英雄流放！這樣我就不會 用「毒素」腐化年輕人的思 想
向他們散播我那些「怪異」 觀念與「變態」生活方式。 哼……偏狹的蠢貨。
你看，船長，你我其實沒那 麼不同。
我們都與多數 VUX 不同，所以在 VUX 眼中，我們兩個都是怪物。

entries.label: take_by_force
entries.body: We require the Shofixti Maidens. We are prepared to use force if necessary.
entries.source: We require the Shofixti Maidens. We are prepared to use force if necessary.
entries.translation: 我們需要索菲克斯提少女。 必要時，我們準備動用武 力。

entries.label: PRECURSOR_DEVICE
entries.body:
Hee! Hee! Hee! Oh, Captain, that would be such an unfortunate mistake
a grave error on both our parts.
We have so much to learn from each other, so much to give each other.
It would be such a sad loss if we were to fall back to the mindless blasting and killing
that has marred our two species' relationship up to this point.
Admittedly, as THE acknowledged VUX military genius
I would find it interesting to face your ONE powerful, alien starship
with my huge personal fleet of Intruders, but oh! What a mistake it would be.
Also... I think it only fair to warn you, Captain
that in my campaigns I collected many interesting items.
Amongst these treasures is a Precursor artifact, a warp nullification field
that prevents nearby ships from making emergency HyperSpace maneuvers... from running away.
I note by the scars on the rear of your vessel that you have made many such escapes.
So you see, Captain, if you attack me, you will face the greatest military tactician in VUX history
commanding an almost infinite number of enemy combat ships
and the battle will be to the Death!
Surely we can find an alternative.

entries.translation:
嘻！嘻！嘻！喔，船長， 那會是個不幸的錯誤
也是我們雙方都犯下的嚴重 失誤。
我們有那麼多能向彼此學 習，也有那麼多能給予彼 此。
若退回到那種毫無理智的轟 炸殺戮，會是多麼可悲的損 失
那種行為至今一直破壞著兩 族關係。
不瞞你說，身為公認的 VUX 第一軍事天才
讓你那唯一一艘強大的外星 星艦
對上我龐大的私人入侵艦艦 隊，確實會很有趣，但啊！ 那會是多大的錯誤。
還有……船長， 我想最好公平地警告你
我在歷次戰役中收集了許多 有趣的物品。
這些珍寶中有一件先驅者造 物，一種躍遷抑制力場
能阻止附近船艦緊急進入超 空間……阻止它們逃跑。
我注意到你的船尾傷痕累 累，顯然你曾多次用這種方 法逃走。
所以你看，船長， 如果攻擊我，你將面對 VUX 史上最偉大的軍事戰術家
指揮近乎無限數量的敵方戰 鬥船艦
而這場戰鬥將至死方休！
我們肯定能找到別的辦法。

entries.label: regardless
entries.body: We will fight you regardless of your Precursor Artifact!
entries.source: We will fight you regardless of your Precursor Artifact!
entries.translation: 不管你有什麼先驅者造物， 我們都要和你一戰！

entries.label: THEN_FIGHT
entries.body: Very well... to the Death!
entries.source: Very well... to the Death!
entries.translation: 很好……至死方休！

entries.label: you_lied
entries.body: You lied, Admiral ZEX!!! There was no `warp nullification field'! Cheater!
entries.source: You lied, Admiral ZEX!!! There was no `warp nullification field'! Cheater!
entries.translation: 你撒謊，澤克斯上將！！！ 根本沒有什麼「躍遷抑制力 場」！騙子！

entries.label: YUP_LIED
entries.body:
Yes, I lied.
Surely, if a small falsehood can prevent hundreds of unnecessary deaths, this is acceptable.
Unfortunately, you saw through my falsehood and no doubt lives were lost.
Let us cease this mindless aggression, before it is our undoing.

對，我撒了謊。
如果一個小小謊言能避免數 百條不必要的性命消逝， 當然可以接受。
不幸的是，你識破了謊言， 想必也有人因此喪命。
在這種無謂的侵略毀掉我們 以前，住手吧。

entries.label: kill_you
entries.body: We have no fear of any of your `devices'. Now we kill you!
entries.source: We have no fear of any of your `devices'. Now we kill you!
entries.translation: 我們不怕你的任何「裝 置」。現在就殺了你！

entries.label: FIGHT_AGAIN
entries.body:
Unfortunate. Dreary... and unfortunate.
Captain, even without such a device, you must understand the overwhelming forces I have at my command!
You cannot beat me here. It is impossible.
But... if a fight is what you demand, so be it.

entries.translation:
真不幸。乏味…… 而且不幸。
船長，就算沒有那種裝置， 你也必須明白我掌握的兵力 具壓倒性優勢！
你不可能在這裡擊敗我。 絕無可能。
但……既然你要求一戰， 那就來吧。

entries.label: bye_zex
entries.body: Goodbye, Admiral ZEX.
entries.source: Goodbye, Admiral ZEX.
entries.translation: 再見，澤克斯上將。

entries.label: GOODBYE_ZEX
entries.body: Goodbye, beautiful human. I hope we can meet someday as friends... perhaps even more.
entries.source: Goodbye, beautiful human. I hope we can meet someday as friends... perhaps even more.
entries.translation: 再見，美麗的人類。 希望有一天我們能以朋友身 分重逢……或許還能更加親 密。

entries.label: HOMEWORLD_HELLO_1
entries.body:
Welcome to the end of your life, courtesy of VUX technology.
Our infinite supply of Intruder vessels are even now locking their vaporizers onto your position
and we shall end your painful, grotesque existence for you as soon as possible.
In the meantime, here is a little music...

歡迎來到生命的終點，由 VUX 科技竭誠提供。
我們取之不盡的入侵艦， 此刻正把汽化器鎖定你的位 置
並會盡快替你結束痛苦、 怪誕的存在。
在此同時，請欣賞一點音 樂……

entries.label: HOMEWORLD_HELLO_2
entries.body:
Hello again.  We trust you are enjoying trespassing in VUX space
and look forward to removing you from existence at our earliest possible convenience.
If you believe you can fight your way past our invincible forces to our surface, you are correct.
Some ash and a few wisps of pungent vapor are sure to make it at least that far.
Our special today is particle fragmentation!
So if you will kindly open your feeding orifice and start screaming, we will begin.

又見面了。我們相信你很享 受擅闖 VUX 空域
也期待在最方便的時機抹除 你的存在。
如果你認為自己能一路突破 我們無敵的軍力抵達地表， 你是對的。
總會有些灰燼和幾縷刺鼻蒸 氣，至少能飄到那麼遠。
今日特餐是粒子碎裂！
所以麻煩你張開進食孔開始 尖叫，我們要動手了。

entries.label: HOMEWORLD_HELLO_3
entries.body:
Welcome back to total annihilation, where, as they say
once is silatious, twice is phlagrant melons
but the third time is when it really hurts.
Please stay seated until your vessel starts smoking
then feel free to dash your head painfully against the floor.

歡迎再次回到徹底殲滅， 正如俗話所說
一次是西拉修斯， 兩次是弗拉格蘭特瓜
但第三次才真的會痛。
請留在座位上， 直到你的船開始冒煙
接著就儘管把腦袋狠狠撞向 地板吧。

entries.label: HOMEWORLD_HELLO_4
entries.body:
Congratulations for exhausting the VUX vocabulary of greetings to despicable life-forms.
May we take this opportunity to lock our femoral scrapers onto your ship
and to wish you an unpleasant afterlife.

entries.translation:
恭喜你耗盡了 VUX 用來問候卑劣生命體的所有 詞彙。
容我們趁這個機會把股骨刮 刀鎖定你的船
並祝你有個不愉快的來世。

entries.label: SPACE_HELLO_1
entries.body:
Greetings from VUX!... the last word in life form destruction!
To gain an intimate knowledge of our engines of war
simply place both hands over your eyes and count to three.
entries.source:

simply place both hands over your eyes and count to three.
entries.translation:
VUX 向你致意！…… 生命體毀滅的終極權威！
若想深入了解我們的戰爭機 器
只要用雙手摀住眼睛， 數到三。

entries.label: SPACE_HELLO_2
entries.body:
Salutations, and may your sense of self-preservation always be so dim.
As our Intruders surround your vessel, you may care to raise both hands into the air above you
and practice the ancient chant of the prancing oowee master, ZEN DUX, which begins...
`AAAAAAAAA AAAAAAHH!!!'

向你致意，也願你的自保意 識永遠如此遲鈍。
當入侵艦包圍你的船時， 不妨把雙手高舉過頭
練習蹦跳烏威大師贊・達克 斯的古老吟唱，開頭是……
「AAAAAAAAA AAAAAAHH!!!」

entries.label: SPACE_HELLO_3
entries.body:
This is VUX Commander YAX.  On behalf of the team here
I would like to say how very much we have all enjoyed taunting you
and to congratulate you on plumbing the limits of VUX courtesy
which you have now exhausted. Therefore, let me just say
Die, you two-eyed loathsome faceless slug!

entries.translation:
我是 VUX 指揮官亞克斯。 謹代表這裡的團隊
表示我們大家有多麼享受嘲 弄你
並恭喜你探到了 VUX 禮數的極限
如今已經徹底耗盡。 所以我只想說
去死吧，你這長著兩顆眼 睛、噁心又沒臉的蛞蝓！

entries.label: SPACE_HELLO_4
entries.body:
Welcome back. All our coherent destructors are currently off-line
but if you'd care to hold your present course and speed
one will be free to annihilate you shortly.
entries.source:
Welcome back. All our coherent destructors are currently off-line
but if you'd care to hold your present course and speed
one will be free to annihilate you shortly.
entries.translation:
歡迎回來。我們所有相干毀 滅器目前都離線
但只要你願意保持目前航向 與速度
很快就會有一具騰出手來殲 滅你。

entries.label: kill_you_squids_1
entries.body: You grotesque squids! We will kill you for your insolence!
entries.source: You grotesque squids! We will kill you for your insolence!
entries.translation: 你們這些怪誕的魷魚！ 我們要因你們的無禮殺了你 們！

entries.label: kill_you_squids_2
entries.body: You are the most vile, repulsive creature I've ever seen!
entries.source: You are the most vile, repulsive creature I've ever seen!
entries.translation: 你是我見過最卑劣、 最令人作嘔的生物！

entries.label: kill_you_squids_3
entries.body: I must say, your rating on the vomit-meter would be AT LEAST ninety six.
entries.source: I must say, your rating on the vomit-meter would be AT LEAST ninety six.
entries.translation: 不得不說，你在嘔吐指數上 的評分至少有九十六。

entries.label: kill_you_squids_4
entries.body: You bloated bag of protoplasm! You worm!
entries.source: You bloated bag of protoplasm! You worm!
entries.translation: 你這腫脹的原生質袋！ 你這條蟲！

entries.label: WE_FIGHT
entries.body: Watch everybody! We're going to kill the repulsive little monster now!
entries.source: Watch everybody! We're going to kill the repulsive little monster now!
entries.translation: 大家看好！我們現在要殺掉 這隻噁心的小怪物！

entries.label: why_so_mean
entries.body: Why are you so hostile toward our species?
entries.source: Why are you so hostile toward our species?
entries.translation: 你們為什麼對我們的物種如 此敵視？

entries.label: URQUAN_SLAVES
entries.body:
Augh! You are even uglier than I had thought possible!
Can't you see you are making me sick?
Please, foul creature, turn your head, or better yet, put a sack over it.
Never mind, I have adjusted my display so it is dim enough to be tolerable.
In answer to your question, our response is simple.
We must attack you because our masters the Ur-Quan wish it so!
Now if you don't mind, stop nodding your head like that.
We VUX do not share this range of motion
and it appears as though your neck is broken
and you are a jabbering corpse. Ugh.

entries.translation:
呃啊！你比我所能想像的還 醜！
難道看不出來你讓我想吐 嗎？
拜託，你這骯髒生物， 把頭轉開；或者更好， 套個袋子吧。
算了，我已調暗顯示畫面， 現在勉強能忍受。
回答你的問題， 我們的理由很簡單。
我們必須攻擊你， 因為主人烏爾關希望如此！
現在如果你不介意， 別再那樣點頭。
我們 VUX 沒有這種活動範圍
那會讓你的脖子看來像是已 經折斷
而你是一具喋喋不休的屍 體。噁。

entries.label: deeper_reason
entries.body: Is there another reason you hate us? Come on, tell me the truth.
entries.source: Is there another reason you hate us? Come on, tell me the truth.
entries.translation: 你們還有其他憎恨我們的理 由嗎？來吧，說實話。

entries.label: OLD_INSULT
entries.body:
Do we need another reason?
Ah! I understand. You refer to the First Human Encounter
the Insult!
What more can be said? On that day, your species proved its true crass nature.
You see, we VUX pride ourselves on our open-mindedness
our ability to see beyond even the most bizarre and disgusting face like yours
but that insult was so low, so totally reprehensible that we will never forget it.
Yes, to be honest, that event pretty much fixed our attitude setting at `ABHOR'.
I suspect we will despise you forever.

啊！我明白了。 你指的是人類初次接觸事件
那次侮辱！
還能說什麼？那一天， 你們的物種證明了自己真正 粗俗的本性。
你看，我們 VUX 以思想開放為傲
就連你這種最怪異、 最噁心的面孔， 我們都有能力看穿表象
但那次侮辱實在太卑劣、 太可鄙，我們永遠不會忘 記。
沒錯，老實說， 那次事件幾乎把我們的態度 設定固定在「憎惡」。
我想我們會永遠鄙視你。

entries.label: if_we_apologize
entries.body: What if we apologized? Could we talk truce then?
entries.source: What if we apologized? Could we talk truce then?
entries.translation: 如果我們道歉呢？ 那能談談停戰嗎？

entries.label: PROBABLY_NOT
entries.body:
Er... probably not. You see, although we VUX are highly reasonable beings
who would never judge a race solely on its (urk!) appearance
the magnitude of your Captain Rand's insult was such that we will probably never forgive your species.
entries.source:
Er... probably not. You see, although we VUX are highly reasonable beings
who would never judge a race solely on its (urk!) appearance
the magnitude of your Captain Rand's insult was such that we will probably never forgive your species.
entries.translation:
呃……大概不能。你看， 儘管我們 VUX 是極為理性的生物
絕不會單憑一個種族（呃 噁！）的外表加以評判
但你們蘭德船長的侮辱實在 太過分，我們大概永遠無法 原諒你們的物種。

entries.label: try_any_way
entries.body: Well, I'll try anyway. The People of Earth Hereby Apologize To The VUX!
entries.source: Well, I'll try anyway. The People of Earth Hereby Apologize To The VUX!
entries.translation: 好吧，我還是要試試。 地球人民在此向 VUX 道歉！

entries.label: NOPE
entries.body:
Nope. I didn't think that would be sufficient. It lacked conviction.
Sorry, but I'm afraid we'll just have to kill you now.
entries.source:
Nope. I didn't think that would be sufficient. It lacked conviction.
Sorry, but I'm afraid we'll just have to kill you now.
entries.translation:
不行。我就知道這不夠。 缺乏誠意。
抱歉，恐怕我們只好現在殺 了你。

entries.label: APOLOGIZE_IN_SPACE
entries.body:
Because the Human named Rand offended one of our starship commanders
apologizing here at the Homeworld is useless.
Besides, we have decided that you are just too disgusting to live
so we have decided to vaporize you.
entries.source:
Because the Human named Rand offended one of our starship commanders
apologizing here at the Homeworld is useless.
Besides, we have decided that you are just too disgusting to live
so we have decided to vaporize you.
entries.translation:
既然是一個叫蘭德的人類冒 犯了我們的一名星艦指揮官
在母星這裡道歉毫無用處。
此外，我們已認定你醜陋得 不配活著
所以決定把你汽化。

entries.label: apology_1
entries.body: Let's try that again. We, The People Of Earth, Really Truly Apologize For The Stupid Insult Made By Captain Rand!
entries.source: Let's try that again. We, The People Of Earth, Really Truly Apologize For The Stupid Insult Made By Captain Rand!
entries.translation: 再試一次。我們地球人民， 真心誠意為蘭德船長那句愚 蠢侮辱道歉！

entries.label: NOT_ACCEPTED_1
entries.body: No. That didn't cut it either.
entries.source: No. That didn't cut it either.
entries.translation: 不。這次也不夠格。

entries.label: apology_2
entries.body: You were RIGHT! We WERE wrong. We see it all so clearly now!
entries.source: You were RIGHT! We WERE wrong. We see it all so clearly now!
entries.translation: 你們說對了！我們錯了。 我們現在看得一清二楚！

entries.label: NOT_ACCEPTED_2
entries.body: I don't think your heart is in it.
entries.source: I don't think your heart is in it.
entries.translation: 我覺得你沒有真心。

entries.label: apology_3
entries.body: Pleeeeeeeeease forgive us!
entries.source: Pleeeeeeeeease forgive us!
entries.translation: 拜——託——原諒我們！

entries.label: NOT_ACCEPTED_3
entries.body: You said that just because you want stuff from us VUX. You didn't really mean it.
entries.source: You said that just because you want stuff from us VUX. You didn't really mean it.
entries.translation: 你這麼說，只是因為想從我 們 VUX 這裡拿東西。你根本不是真 心的。

entries.label: apology_4
entries.body: We - are - sorry! May a thousand insects sting my softest parts if I lie!
entries.source: We - are - sorry! May a thousand insects sting my softest parts if I lie!
entries.translation: 我－們－很－抱－歉！ 如果我撒謊，就讓一千隻蟲 叮我最柔軟的部位！

entries.label: NOT_ACCEPTED_4
entries.body: It's pointless. Why even bother trying again?
entries.source: It's pointless. Why even bother trying again?
entries.translation: 毫無意義。何必再試一次？

entries.label: apology_5
entries.body: We would like to present a petition of 1 million signatures! Each one says, `I'm sorry!'
entries.source: We would like to present a petition of 1 million signatures! Each one says, `I'm sorry!'
entries.translation: 我們想提交一份有一百萬個 簽名的請願書！ 每一個簽名都寫著「我很抱 歉！」

entries.label: NOT_ACCEPTED_5
entries.body: A good try, Captain... but not good enough.
entries.source: A good try, Captain... but not good enough.
entries.translation: 船長，試得不錯…… 但還不夠好。

entries.label: apology_6
entries.body: Wrong? Yes we were wrong. Oh, so wrong! Boy, were we wrong! The wrongest.
entries.source: Wrong? Yes we were wrong. Oh, so wrong! Boy, were we wrong! The wrongest.
entries.translation: 錯了？對，我們錯了。喔， 真是大錯特錯！天啊， 我們錯慘了！錯得無以復 加。

entries.label: NOT_ACCEPTED_6
entries.body: We detect a hint of genuine regret, but not enough to forgive you.
entries.source: We detect a hint of genuine regret, but not enough to forgive you.
entries.translation: 我們察覺到一絲真誠悔意， 但還不足以原諒你。

entries.label: apology_7
entries.body: (Let's try reverse psychology) Listen VUX! You are right! We cannot ever atone for Rand's cruel barb!
entries.source: (Let's try reverse psychology) Listen VUX! You are right! We cannot ever atone for Rand's cruel barb!
entries.translation: （來試試逆向心理）聽著， VUX！你們說得對！ 我們永遠無法彌補蘭德那句 殘酷嘲諷！

entries.label: NOT_ACCEPTED_7
entries.body:
Oh? I was just thinking that maybe we should consider forgiving you
but I guess you're right.
There's no going back.
entries.source:
Oh? I was just thinking that maybe we should consider forgiving you
but I guess you're right.
There's no going back.
entries.translation:
喔？我剛才還在想， 也許我們應該考慮原諒你們
但我想你說得對。
已經回不了頭了。

entries.label: apology_8
entries.body: If sorrow were a pebble, our remorse would be... would be!... a great big boulder!
entries.source: If sorrow were a pebble, our remorse would be... would be!... a great big boulder!
entries.translation: 如果悲傷是一顆卵石， 我們的悔恨就是……就 是！……一塊巨大巨石！

entries.label: NOT_ACCEPTED_8
entries.body:
Hey! That was pretty good!
I could sense the true sadness in your voice for your species' past stupidity.
Unfortunately, it was not good enough.
entries.source:
Hey! That was pretty good!
I could sense the true sadness in your voice for your species' past stupidity.
Unfortunately, it was not good enough.
entries.translation:
嘿！這句說得真不錯！
我能從你的聲音中， 感受到你對自己物種過往愚 蠢行徑的真實悲痛。
可惜還是不夠好。

entries.label: apology_9
entries.body: If there is ANYTHING we can do to gain your forgiveness, we shall do it a thousand times.
entries.source: If there is ANYTHING we can do to gain your forgiveness, we shall do it a thousand times.
entries.translation: 只要有任何事能換得原諒， 我們都願意做上一千次。

entries.label: NOT_ACCEPTED_9
entries.body:
Um..., er... that was about as good as it gets, I think
but we don't accept it because... because... well, just BECAUSE!
entries.source:
Um..., er... that was about as good as it gets, I think
but we don't accept it because... because... well, just BECAUSE!
entries.translation:
嗯……呃……我想， 這大概已經好到不能再好了
但我們不接受，因為…… 因為……哼，就是不接受！

entries.label: apology_10
entries.body: Please, for the love of reason. Heed these words: We, the People of Earth Apologize To The VUX.
entries.source: Please, for the love of reason. Heed these words: We, the People of Earth Apologize To The VUX.
entries.translation: 拜託，看在理性的份上聽 好：我們地球人民向 VUX 道歉。

entries.label: TRUTH
entries.body:
AIEEE! Human! You have hounded and hounded and hounded us with your pitiful apologies!
It's driving us crazy! STOP! Please STOP!
We give up. We accept! We accept! We will no longer hold Rand's insult against your species.
You are forgiven for all eternity, just stop apologizing!
But now you have forced us to reveal our REAL reason for hating you humans
an embarrassing reason with no acceptable justification, but nonetheless undeniable!
Human! You are SOOO ugly, SOOO hideous to us that we will NEVER be able to find peace with your species!
Whenever we see your kind, we just want to kick you!... stomp on you!... squish you!...
...vaporize your ugly faces from the entire universe!
We know its unreasonable! We know that you had no choice about how you look!
We know that it is cruel fate that the Creator made you appear like putrid excretion
but WE JUST CAN'T HANDLE IT!
Why right now, because of your insufferable wretchedness
I am faced with a grotesque choice: keep talking to you and regurgitate uncontrollably
or break off communication and attack your vessel...
entries.source:
AIEEE! Human! You have hounded and hounded and hounded us with your pitiful apologies!
It's driving us crazy! STOP! Please STOP!
We give up. We accept! We accept! We will no longer hold Rand's insult against your species.
You are forgiven for all eternity, just stop apologizing!
But now you have forced us to reveal our REAL reason for hating you humans
an embarrassing reason with no acceptable justification, but nonetheless undeniable!
Human! You are SOOO ugly, SOOO hideous to us that we will NEVER be able to find peace with your species!
Whenever we see your kind, we just want to kick you!... stomp on you!... squish you!...
...vaporize your ugly faces from the entire universe!
We know its unreasonable! We know that you had no choice about how you look!
We know that it is cruel fate that the Creator made you appear like putrid excretion
but WE JUST CAN'T HANDLE IT!
Why right now, because of your insufferable wretchedness
I am faced with a grotesque choice: keep talking to you and regurgitate uncontrollably
or break off communication and attack your vessel...
entries.translation:
啊咿咿咿！人類！ 你用那可悲的道歉糾纏、 糾纏、糾纏我們！
快把我們逼瘋了！住口！ 拜託住口！
我們投降。我們接受！ 接受！我們不再拿蘭德的侮 辱怪罪你們的物種。
我們永遠原諒你們， 只要別再道歉了！
但現在你逼得我們必須揭露 自己憎恨人類的真正理由
一個令人難堪、 毫無正當藉口， 卻又無可否認的理由！
人類！對我們而言， 你們實在太——醜、 太——可怕，我們永遠不可 能與你們和平相處！
每次見到你們， 我們就只想踢你！…… 踩你！……壓扁你！……
……把你們的醜臉從整個宇 宙汽化！
我們知道這不合理！ 我們知道你們無法選擇自己 的長相！
我們知道，是造物主讓你們 看來像腐爛排泄物的殘酷命 運
但我們就是受不了！
就像現在，正因為你令人無 法忍受的醜惡
我面臨一個怪誕的選擇： 繼續和你交談，並失控嘔吐
或中斷通訊，攻擊你的船 艦……

entries.label: whats_up_hostile
entries.body: VUX. We seek to learn more about you. Maybe then we can see eye to... eyes.
entries.source: VUX. We seek to learn more about you. Maybe then we can see eye to... eyes.
entries.translation: VUX，我們想進一步了解 你們。也許這樣我們就能以 眼……對雙眼。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_HOSTILE_1
entries.body:
Look, vomitous alien. If you want to talk to one of our species
without making them sick
why don't you go see Admiral ZEX at his world in Alpha Cerenkov.
He (urp!) likes humans.
entries.source:
Look, vomitous alien. If you want to talk to one of our species
without making them sick
why don't you go see Admiral ZEX at his world in Alpha Cerenkov.
He (urp!) likes humans.
entries.translation:
聽著，你這令人作嘔的外星 人。如果想和我們其中一員 交談
又不讓對方噁心
何不去切倫科夫阿爾法的世 界找澤克斯上將。
他（呃噁！）喜歡人類。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_HOSTILE_2
entries.body:
Look at those yellowish-white hard things in your mouth!
How do you keep from biting off that pulpy organ... Gross!
entries.source:
Look at those yellowish-white hard things in your mouth!
How do you keep from biting off that pulpy organ... Gross!
entries.translation:
看看你嘴裡那些黃白色的堅 硬東西！
你怎麼不會把那個肉乎乎的 器官咬斷……真噁心！

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_HOSTILE_3
entries.body: Yuck! Don't show your tongue like that. It makes me sick.
entries.source: Yuck! Don't show your tongue like that. It makes me sick.
entries.translation: 噁！別那樣露出舌頭。 害我想吐。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_HOSTILE_4
entries.body:
Forget it, human. We can't think straight when we have to look at you.
If you're lonely, go to Alpha Cerenkov and talk with that pervert, Admiral ZEX.
entries.source:
Forget it, human. We can't think straight when we have to look at you.
If you're lonely, go to Alpha Cerenkov and talk with that pervert, Admiral ZEX.
entries.translation:
算了吧，人類。 只要必須看著你， 我們就無法正常思考。
如果寂寞，就去切倫科夫阿 爾法找那個變態澤克斯上將 談談。

entries.label: cant_we_be_friends_1
entries.body: Why can't we be friends? I like YOU.
entries.source: Why can't we be friends? I like YOU.
entries.translation: 我們為什麼不能當朋友？ 我喜歡你。

entries.label: NEVER_UGLY_HUMANS_1
entries.body:
I listened. I heard. I know you like ME.
But the problem is, I DESPISE you!
Which is why I am attacking, in case you were wondering.
entries.source:
I listened. I heard. I know you like ME.
But the problem is, I DESPISE you!
Which is why I am attacking, in case you were wondering.
entries.translation:
我聽了。我聽見了。 我知道你喜歡我。
但問題在於，我鄙視你！
如果你正好想知道， 這就是我發動攻擊的原因。

entries.label: cant_we_be_friends_2
entries.body: We have too much to gain through cooperation. Just try.
entries.source: We have too much to gain through cooperation. Just try.
entries.translation: 合作能帶來太多好處。 試試看就好。

entries.label: NEVER_UGLY_HUMANS_2
entries.body:
Okay, I'll try to like you.
I'm really trying.
Naw! This is never going to work.
Every time I try to think of your friendly smiling face
(urp!) I want to blow chunks.
I have a better idea. I'll just kill you.
entries.source:
Okay, I'll try to like you.
I'm really trying.
Naw! This is never going to work.
Every time I try to think of your friendly smiling face
(urp!) I want to blow chunks.
I have a better idea. I'll just kill you.
entries.translation:
好吧，我試著喜歡你。
我真的很努力。
不行！永遠都行不通。
每當我試著想像你那張友善 的笑臉
（呃噁！）我就想大吐特 吐。
我有個更好的主意。 乾脆殺了你。

entries.label: cant_we_be_friends_3
entries.body: Didn't anyone ever tell you, `you can't judge a book by its cover?'
entries.source: Didn't anyone ever tell you, `you can't judge a book by its cover?'
entries.translation: 難道從沒有人告訴你， 「不能只憑封面評斷一本 書」嗎？

entries.label: NEVER_UGLY_HUMANS_3
entries.body:
Do you want to know how ugly you are to us VUX? I'll tell you.
You humans are SO ugly, that I get my kids to behave by holding a picture of you behind my back
and I tell the kids that if they aren't good, I'll show it to them!
I am such a bad father (sob!) I must destroy you... for the children!
entries.source:
Do you want to know how ugly you are to us VUX? I'll tell you.
You humans are SO ugly, that I get my kids to behave by holding a picture of you behind my back
and I tell the kids that if they aren't good, I'll show it to them!
I am such a bad father (sob!) I must destroy you... for the children!
entries.translation:
想知道在我們 VUX 眼中你有多醜嗎？ 我告訴你。
你們人類醜到只要我的孩子 不聽話，我就會把你的照片 藏在背後
再告訴孩子，如果不乖就拿 給他們看！
我真是個壞父親（啜 泣！）我必須摧毀你…… 為了孩子！

entries.label: cant_we_be_friends_4
entries.body: You are just a bunch of bigots. I thought you were better than that.
entries.source: You are just a bunch of bigots. I thought you were better than that.
entries.translation: 你們只是一群偏狹之徒。 我還以為你們沒那麼糟。

entries.label: NEVER_UGLY_HUMANS_4
entries.body:
This IS embarrassing. We pride ourselves on being rational!
But you are so disgusting that we feel we just HAVE to kill you!
Like right now!
entries.source:
This IS embarrassing. We pride ourselves on being rational!
But you are so disgusting that we feel we just HAVE to kill you!
Like right now!
entries.translation:
這的確令人難堪。 我們以理性為傲！
但你實在太噁心， 讓我們覺得非殺了你不可！
就現在！

entries.label: bye_hostile_space
entries.body: Well, THIS has been useless. Goodbye.
entries.source: Well, THIS has been useless. Goodbye.
entries.translation: 好吧，這完全是浪費時間。 再見。

entries.label: GOODBYE_AND_DIE_HOSTILE_SPACE_1
entries.body:
Human, based upon our commitment to the Ur-Quan
and your general disgusting demeanor, we have decided to blow you to bits.
entries.source:
Human, based upon our commitment to the Ur-Quan
and your general disgusting demeanor, we have decided to blow you to bits.
entries.translation:
人類，基於我們對烏爾關的 承諾
以及你整體令人噁心的行 止，我們決定把你炸成碎 片。

entries.label: GOODBYE_AND_DIE_HOSTILE_SPACE_2
entries.body:
Wait! I have one last thing to say
Die!
entries.source:
Wait! I have one last thing to say
Die!
entries.translation:
等等！我還有最後一句話
去死吧！

entries.label: GOODBYE_AND_DIE_HOSTILE_SPACE_3
entries.body: For the good of the whole, I will now erase your putrid presence.
entries.source: For the good of the whole, I will now erase your putrid presence.
entries.translation: 為了整體的福祉， 現在我要抹除你腐臭的存 在。

entries.label: GOODBYE_AND_DIE_HOSTILE_SPACE_4
entries.body: We have no choice. You are too wretched. We shall eliminate you.
entries.source: We have no choice. You are too wretched. We shall eliminate you.
entries.translation: 我們別無選擇。 你太卑劣了。我們要消滅 你。

entries.label: OUT_TAKES
entries.body:
Oh no! It's one of those ultra-gross humans again!
Quick, hide your eye!
AGGH! Look at the pulpy red thing in its mouth
how it wriggles and writhes like a wet blood worm
and plays over the hard white nubs that protrude from its headbone!
I think I'm going to be sick.
entries.source:
Oh no! It's one of those ultra-gross humans again!
Quick, hide your eye!
AGGH! Look at the pulpy red thing in its mouth
how it wriggles and writhes like a wet blood worm
and plays over the hard white nubs that protrude from its headbone!
I think I'm going to be sick.
entries.translation:
喔不！又是那種超級噁心的 人類！
快，遮住你的眼睛！
啊啊！看牠嘴裡那個肉乎乎 的紅色東西
扭動、蠕動得像一條濕淋淋 的血蟲
還在牠頭骨上突出的堅硬白 色小疙瘩間游移！
我快吐了。
